name: IC 3225 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3225, a spiral galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3225-hubble
story: IC 3225 looks remarkably as if it has been launched from a cannon. As it races through the Virgo Cluster, ram pressure strips gas out of it, and more stars have formed along its leading edge while its far end is stretched out of shape.

claims.text: IC 3225 is a member of the Virgo galaxy cluster
It looks as if launched from a cannon
Ram pressure strips gas from moving galaxies
More star formation on the leading edge, the opposite end stretched
'Celestial cannonball' is the title of the Hubble image release
